name: zig

allocations.name: zig
allocations.purpose: Zig compiled objects and downloaded packages

notes: Use the project's Zig version and build steps. Keep .zig-cache and zig-out project-local. Keep the global cache per checkout: newer Zig caches can retain source paths from another checkout, which that sandbox cannot read. Do not rewrite build.zig for a mismatched installed compiler: report the missing prerequisite. Dependency fetches remain sandboxed.
